skyrally.signature: Branch three ways along the coast: beach, cavern or the cliff roof.

coins.note: at the top of the crest-jump arc

key.note: water-side alcove right of the cavern mouth; drive off the line through the inlet shallows

venue.note: the first water-battle disc: the art pass keeps props, foam and spray out of it

plank.name: GalleonPlank
plank.note: physical kicker, no pad: from rest on the deck the car leaves the lip at lipSpeed and lands on the Plank Dune (dry at every tide); slower cars drop onto the bank against the hull, faster ones further along the dune and its spit to the beach crest

dune.note: Plank Dune: sand bank under the lower gangways and the plank landing, spit to the beach crest; dry at every tide, so the decks are never an island

barriers.name: CavernMouthBarrier
barriers.note: battle only (server/battle/BattleBarriers): collider jamb to jamb from under the road to the arch spring, CanCollide + CanQuery for the car's wall rays; props behind its arena face

salute.note: the starboard gunport cannon beside the Walk the Plank kicker fires a salute (client only)

battle.note: shallows bed -1.0 below sea level; ground deeper than drownDepth under the tide level drowns (CarController WATER_SINK_DEPTH), so each step closes the low sand toward the beach crest, the Plank Dune and the decks. spawnLooks: authored seat/respawn headings, one per spawn (the deck pad looks down the aft gangway)

boss.hazard: dropped mines, then bubbles in rematch

framing.note: start grid looks north up the crescent beach: galleon in the cove at 10 o'clock, cavern mouth arch ahead in the headland, key alcove and inlet to its right (10_ISLAND2_CRESCENT_ISLAND.png)
